figures.finding: Ghana's Film Development Fund, set up under section 29 of the Development and Classification of Film Act 2016 (Act 935) and launched by the National Film Authority on 20 May 2026 with GH¢20 million of seed money in the 2026 budget (GH¢5 million released by June 2026), is a revolving fund: it finances up to 60% of a project's budget, to be repaid from the project's revenue; applications opened on 31 July 2026.

sources.said: Presenting the 2026 Budget Statement on November 13, 2025, Finance Minister Cassiel Ato Forson announced a GH¢20 million allocation to the Film Development Fund as seed money … “Government has so far released 5 million cedis as part of the 20 million cedis seed fund commitment,” she told Kwame Dadzie of Myjoyonline.com . … Beneficiaries are expected to repay funds received for their projects.

On 20th May, 2026, the Ghanaian National Film Authority (NF … the NFA announced the application for the fund starting from 31st July 2026 . The Fund is established under Section 29, Act, 2016 (Act 935) of the Development and Classification of Film … The Fund supports five categories in accordance with section 30 of Act 935. … The FDF is designed as a revolving fund. … Successful applicants may access up to 60% of their project’s budget.
